title: Media data flow
description: What data is moving through the media stack: qBittorrent and VPN, arr queues and imports, Prowlarr, Jellyfin playback, DVD rips and CephFS volume fill.

panels.title: VPN tunnel (gluetun)
panels.description: gluetun sidecar of the qbittorrent pod is Ready (tunnel up and healthy). gluetun exposes no Prometheus metrics of its own.

panels.title: Port forwarded / reachable
panels.description: qBittorrent's own connection status: 'connected' means the VPN-forwarded port is reachable; 'firewalled' means no inbound port.

panels.title: Data moved per hour
panels.description: Hourly increase of qBittorrent's all-time transfer counters.

panels.title: Torrents by state
panels.description: Active/stalled/queued/error torrents. stalledDL = downloading but no peers; stalledUP = seeding with no demand.

panels.title: Free space on download disk and queued bytes
Health warnings
panels.description: Number of active health issues across the arr apps (update-available warnings included).

panels.title: Download queue
panels.description: Items in each arr app's download queue (exportarr; the series exist only while the queue is non-empty, so an empty queue reads 0).

panels.title: Imports per hour
panels.description: Change in the apps' imported-file counts per hour (negative if files are deleted).

panels.title: Now playing
panels.description: Sessions currently playing. The jellyfin_now_playing_* series exist only while something plays.

panels.title: Playback sessions by method
panels.description: Direct play vs transcode (method label), from the playing collector.

panels.title: Jellyfin pod network
panels.description: Pod-level network. Jellyfin has no bandwidth metric of its own; out is dominated by streaming to clients.

panels.title: Volume growth per day
panels.description: Change in used bytes over the trailing day, per volume.
